The short version: hiring an in-house creator manager gives you full control and can be cheaper at large scale, but it means recruiting, training, and hoping one person becomes an expert on your budget. Tokgency gives you a proven process, creator relationships, and reps from day one, with fees you can align to GMV. For most brands scaling TikTok Shop, the agency is the faster, lower-risk path until volume justifies a dedicated hire.

What an in-house hire gives you

  • Full control over strategy and daily decisions.
  • Deep brand knowledge, since they live your product.
  • Lower cost at high volume, where a salary beats a percentage of large GMV.

The catch is that you are betting on one person, and building the function from scratch.

What Tokgency gives you

  • Immediate expertise. A proven process running from day one, no ramp.
  • Existing creator relationships and cross-brand pattern recognition.
  • No hiring risk. A switch you flip, not a role you recruit for.
  • Accountability. Fees that can align to GMV.

In-house manager Tokgency

The daily loop someone has to run

The role is defined by a repeating operational loop. One seller listed it as "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). A first in-house hire has to learn to run all of that on your budget. An agency already runs it across brands from day one.

The hidden problem with a first hire

Most brands cannot keep a creator manager both fully busy and genuinely expert early on. The role ends up underused (paying full-time for part-time work) or over its head (one person cannot match an agency's cross-brand experience). The economics only work once your program is big enough to justify and sharpen the role. We cover this in depth in agency vs in-house.

When an in-house hire is the better pick

  • You are already at high, steady GMV where a salary is cheaper than commission.
  • You want total control and can support a specialist full-time.
  • You have someone great ready to hire.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You want to scale now without a hiring cycle.
  • You do not have enough steady work to keep a specialist busy and sharp.
  • You want a proven process and accountability from day one.

The takeaway

Many brands use Tokgency to build and scale the program, then bring it in-house once volume justifies a dedicated team, sometimes hiring the very playbook we proved. Agency for speed and low risk now, in-house for control and cost later.

Want to scale without a hire? Book a call, or see the creators a program would target.
